# Chenye Ni

Ph.D. student at the University of Auckland, advised by Elliott Wen and Valerio
Terragni. Research on software supply chain security, and reproducible builds in
particular: whether the software you install really came from the source it
claims.

## Publications

- [RustBuildEq: A Benchmark for Binary Equivalence under Build Variability](https://doi.org/10.1145/3805760.3814930):
  AIware 2026. A labelled corpus of Rust binary pairs for learning when build
  differences are benign. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19244908
- [Playsemble: Learning Low-Level Programming Through Interactive Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20167):
  arXiv 2026. Teaching low-level programming through games rather than
  exercises. Project: https://asm.protoyard.com/
